alternatingWorkloadBenchmark.description: Rigorous alternating schedule [BEFORE, AFTER, BEFORE, AFTER, BEFORE, AFTER] with full 50,000-submission reset and VACUUM ANALYZE before each run. Workload: 3,000 requests per run at Concurrency 32 (70% Leaderboard Reads, 30% Submissions)
alternatingWorkloadBenchmark.machine: Apple M1 Pro (8 cores, 16.00 GB RAM)
alternatingWorkloadBenchmark.statisticalAssessment: Workload-level throughput and p95 ranges overlap and runs 1 to 6 drift downward over time, so the end-to-end difference is not distinguishable from noise. Standings recalc medians were 251 ms (before) vs 198 ms (after) but ranges overlap (before min 189, after min 195), n=3, inconclusive.

queryLevelGain.heapFetches: Reduced from 1,471 heap blocks (25,007 rows) to 14 (Index Only Scan)

queryOptimization.targetQuery: SELECT id, contest_id, problem_id, user_id, created_at, authoritative_attempt_id FROM submissions WHERE contest_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND problem_id = $3 ORDER BY created_at ASC
queryOptimization.indexCreated: CREATE INDEX idx_submissions_covering ON submissions (contest_id, user_id, problem_id, created_at ASC) INCLUDE (id, authoritative_attempt_id)
